name: Mor'shan Base Camp
summary: Mor'shan Base Camp is a fortified Horde outpost situated in the northern reaches of the Barrens, just south of the border with Ashenvale. Maintained by the Warsong Outriders, it serves as the vital staging ground and logistics hub for Horde forces pushing into the disputed forests to the north.

sections.title: Staging Ground for Ashenvale
sections.body: Tucked directly behind the formidable Mor'shan Rampart, Mor'shan Base Camp bustles with the movement of warriors, supplies, and scouting parties. It operates as the headquarters and staging ground for the Warsong Outriders, an elite vanguard of orcs fighting to secure lumber and territory against the night elves in Warsong Gulch. For Horde forces trekking north across the dry expanse of the Barrens, this encampment provides vital supplies, war horns, and reinforcements before crossing into the contested, dense canopy of Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is Mor'shan Base Camp used for?
aliases: why is morshan base camp here
faq.answer: Mor'shan Base Camp serves as the main forward garrison for the Warsong Outriders. It is the supply depot, mustering point, and strategic rallying center for Horde troops fighting the night elves in the border skirmishes of Warsong Gulch.
The camp is held entirely by the Horde, specifically staffed and defended by the Warsong Outriders and allied forces stationed along the northern edge of the Barrens.

faq.q: How does this camp relate to the Mor'shan Rampart?
faq.answer: The camp sits directly behind the Mor'shan Rampart, functioning as the active military base and rear supply depot for the fortified wall that marks the boundary between the Barrens and Ashenvale.

angles.text: For the Horde, this base represents the tip of the spear in securing vital timber from Ashenvale and defending northern Kalimdor from night elf incursions.
The camp is operated by the Warsong Outriders, honoring the legacy and tenacious expansionist drive of the Warsong clan.
